name: Chevereto
description: Admin self-updater sets CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER=0/VERIFYHOST=0, zero payload verification, extracts over the live app root, executes via passthru() — unauthenticated RCE. [Opus-verified: CONFIRMED-D]
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The self-upgrader disables both peer and host verification, extracts the ZIP over the live root, and runs the post-upgrade CLI. Admin authentication gates triggering but not payload authenticity.
limitations: Source review is limited to the retained commit and does not establish released-artifact or current-upstream behavior.

original_evidence.text: | Chevereto (OSS/AGPL edition) | https://github.com/chevereto/chevereto.git | 900094d / 2026-08-20 | Y | Y (admin clicks "Upgrade now" in dashboard, then the whole download+extract+DB-migrate flow runs unattended) | **Y — full download + ZIP extract of the live application root, then executes the extracted PHP** | **https URL but TLS certificate validation explicitly DISABLED** | none | **none — no hash, no signature, nothing** | N/A (no verification exists at all) | `app/upgrading.php:253-254` (`curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, 0); curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 0);` inside the shared `curl()` helper used by the updater); `app/upgrading.php:41` (`ZIP_BALL = 'https://chevereto.com/api/download/%tag%'`); `app/upgrading.php:356-392` (`downloadAction()` streams the zip straight to `chevereto.zip`, only checks HTTP 200 — **no hash/signature check of any kind**); `app/upgrading.php:394-434` (`extractAction()` → `ZipArchive::extractTo($pathTo)` extracts directly over the live app root `PATH_APP`/`..`); `app/upgrading.php:214-218` (after extraction, `passthru($rootDir.'/app/bin/cli -C update')` executes the freshly-extracted code); `app/legacy/routes/dashboard.php:90-125` (admin-triggered entry point `dashboard/upgrade`, generates a random token stored server-side and checked with `hash_equals` — this only gates *who can trigger* the upgrade, it does nothing to authenticate *what gets downloaded*). |
